Q5910.reason: A recorded general-plan promise not to build, expressly binding successors who take with notice, is enforced in equity as an equitable servitude rather than as a traditional negative easement.

Q5623.reason: The commentary is opinion about a public protest and a public figure, so the newsworthiness/public-interest privilege defeats an invasion-of-privacy claim.

Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest to the sister’s children who reach 25 can vest long after lives in being plus 21 years, so it is void under the common-law RAP and the friend holds fee simple absolute.
